title: Canonical Demo
purpose: Platform-owned reference sample used to prove the canonical CRUD, lifecycle, orchestration, and metadata surface together.
businessStory: A clinic schedules appointments, completes visits, and triggers downstream claim creation and notification behavior from governed runtime semantics.
walkthrough: Inspect the model and confirm the four canonical concepts are present.
Review the CreateAppointment flow and the Appointment lifecycle transitions.
Generate the sample and inspect the output runtime surfaces and compiled metadata.
expectedOutcomes: The canonical demo remains the stable platform specimen.
Appointment lifecycle and orchestration metadata are present in generated output.
Generated runtime surfaces are suitable for documentation, screenshots, and regression checks.
